CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 977.                                      SHANGHAI,       25th March 1937.

Sir,

      I have the honour to acknowledge the receipt of
your letter, No.D.7846 of the 24th instant regarding
Alexander (Sandor) GUMAN and to thank you for the in-
formation contained therein.

                                          I have the honour to be,
                                                      Sir,
                                          Your obedient servant,
                                          〔此处为手写签名〕
                                          Consul.

Major K.M.Bourne,
   Officer i/c Special Branch,
      Shanghai Municipal Police,
                  SHANGHAI.

                                          （印：SPECIAL BRANCH / KB / 30 MAR. 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No............
S.I. Special Branch. Station,
REPORT
Date March 24. 19 37.

Subject Communication dated March 22. 1937 from the Netherlands Consulate
General, regarding Mr Alexander (Junior) Human.

Made by A.S. Luroy. Forwarded by J Boyne & S I

With reference to the attached letter dated March 22. 1937
from the Netherlands Consulate General concerning Mr Alexander
(Junior) Human who wishes to apply for passport facilities
to enable him to enter the Netherlands Indies : I have to state
that the records of the Municipal Police reveal nothing
detrimental to the name of the aforementioned person.

（批：ddr 24/3）

K Marby.
D. S.

Deputy Commissioner (Special Branch).

CONSULAAT-GENERAAL DER NEDERLANDEN
VOOR MIDDEN-CHINA.
TEL. AD. HOLLANDIA.

No. 931 .
SHANGHAI, 22nd March 1937 . 7846
23 3 37

Sir,

I have the honour to inform you that Mr.Alexander (Sendor)
GUMAN has applied to this Consulate for a visé for admission into
the Netherlands Indies.

He is in possession of a Tsjecho.Slovakian passport No.2188/
54.123/36, issued at Kosice on the 5th November 1936.

According to his passport he was born in Kosicivsk (Kosice)
on the 22nd April 1911.

Mr.Guman, a musician, is in possession of a permit issued by
the Netherlands Indian Government, according to which he is
allowed to accept a position as a musician for the time of one
year in Medan (Sumatra).

He stated that he has been in Canton and Shanghai for the
last three months and that he was working with the Arcwelding &
Diecasting Works,Ltd.,Wuting Road 781, Shanghai.

Mr.Guman intends to sail on the s.s."Scharnhorst", leaving
Shanghai on the 26th March 1937.

I should be much obliged to you if you would let me know,
if possible, whether anything is known against this person from
a political or moral point of view.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Consul.

Major K.M.Bourne,
Officer i/c Special Branch,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
SHANGHAI.

（左侧手写批注：* No previous record in S.B. Reg. 23/3/37）
（右下角印章：SPECIAL BRANCH / 23 MAR 1937 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE）

荷兰驻华中总领事馆
电报挂号：HOLLANDIA。

第931号。
上海，1937年3月22日。 7846
37年3月23日

先生：

谨此通知阁下，亚历山大（森多尔）·古曼（Alexander (Sendor) GUMAN）先生已向本领事馆申请前往荷属东印度的签证。

他持有捷克斯洛伐克护照，号码为2188/54.123/36，于1936年11月5日在科希策（Kosice）签发。

根据其护照记载，他于1911年4月22日出生于科希齐夫斯克（Kosicivsk）（即科希策）。

古曼先生是一名音乐家，持有荷属东印度政府颁发的许可证，根据该许可证，他获准在棉兰（苏门答腊）接受为期一年的音乐家职位。

他表示，过去三个月他一直待在广东和上海，并在上海吴淞路781号的电弧焊接与压铸有限公司（Arcwelding & Diecasting Works, Ltd.）工作。

古曼先生计划乘坐“沙恩霍斯特”号轮船（s.s."Scharnhorst"），该船将于1937年3月26日离开上海。

如蒙告知，从政治或道德角度是否知晓此人有任何不良记录，本人将不胜感激。

谨致
敬礼，
您顺从的仆人，

领事。

K.M.伯恩（K.M.Bourne）少校，
特务处主管，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
上海。

（左侧手写批注：* 特务处登记册中无先前记录 37年3月23日）
（右下角印章：特务处 / 1937年3月23日 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处）
